mapper.select: select discrepancy_case_id from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case where discrepancy_case_id = #{caseId} for update

select confirmation_event_id, request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version, fact_fingerprint, party_role, party_dept_id, decision, confirmation_note, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_time from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event where request_id = #{requestId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event ( request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version, fact_fingerprint, party_role, party_dept_id, decision, confirmation_note, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time ) select #{confirmation.requestId}, c.discrepancy_case_id, c.case_version, c.fact_fingerprint, #{confirmation.partyRole}, #{confirmation.partyDeptId}, #{confirmation.decision}, #{confirmation.note}, #{confirmation.operatorUserId}, #{confirmation.operatorName}, #{confirmation.operatorName}, #{confirmation.createdAt} from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt r on r.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and r.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and r.transfer_id = c.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_order o on o.transfer_id = c.transfer_id where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{confirmation.caseId} and c.case_version = #{confirmation.caseVersion} and c.fact_fingerprint = #{confirmation.factFingerprint} and c.status = 'awaiting_confirmation' and length(#{confirmation.requestId}) between 1 and 128 and #{confirmation.decision} in ('confirmed', 'disputed') and (#{confirmation.note} is null or length(#{confirmation.note}) between 1 and 500) and (#{confirmation.decision} = 'confirmed' or length(trim(#{confirmation.note})) between 1 and 500) and length(#{confirmation.operatorName}) between 1 and 64 and #{confirmation.operatorUserId} > 0 and #{confirmation.partyDeptId} > 0 and ( (#{confirmation.partyRole} = 'source' and #{confirmation.partyDeptId} = coalesce( nullif(o.from_warehouse_id, 0), o.from_dept_id)) or (#{confirmation.partyRole} = 'target' and #{confirmation.partyDeptId} = coalesce( nullif(o.to_warehouse_id, 0), o.to_dept_id)) ) and coalesce(nullif(o.from_warehouse_id, 0), o.from_dept_id) <> coalesce(nullif(o.to_warehouse_id, 0), o.to_dept_id) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event prior where prior.request_id = #{confirmation.requestId} )
